messages.static.localeCoverage.title: Russian interface, English catalog
messages.static.localeCoverage.copy: Navigation and interface text are translated. Curated resource titles, descriptions, taxonomy, and place names remain in canonical English until a human-reviewed translation layer is available.
messages.static.common.supportCopy: If Akashic helps, these are the project's configured ways to contribute financially. Browsing will always remain open.
messages.static.common.footerCopy: Ego Hygiene's living constellation of curated knowledge.
messages.static.home.metaDescription: akashic is Ego Hygiene's living constellation of curated tools, knowledge, research, support, creativity, and open resources.
messages.static.home.ogDescription: Explore Ego Hygiene's living constellation of curated knowledge and open resources.
messages.static.home.heroCopy: Explore akashic: a hand-curated constellation of tools, public resources, research, creative fuel, lived wisdom, and practical support—organized for people, not repositories.
messages.static.home.seeShapeCopy: Read the archive before choosing a path
messages.static.home.findResourceCopy: Search, save, and open what matters
messages.static.home.exploreKnowledgePlaceCopy: Move from the world toward local resources
messages.static.home.countCaveat: Counts describe the present curation—not importance, quality, or completeness.
messages.static.home.ringCopy: All collections appear in the ring. Exact values continue in the full Observatory.
messages.static.home.startNeedCopy: You do not need to know the right agency, collection, product, or technical term. Choose the situation closest to yours.
messages.static.home.collectionDirectoryCopy: A calmer doorway into every collection. Read its guide, browse its resources, or place it in the knowledge map.
messages.static.home.navigateMapCopy: Choose a collection to reveal its topics, then jump directly into that branch of the catalog.
messages.static.home.mapIntro: Choose a constellation to reveal its branches and discover where your curiosity leads.
messages.static.home.mapHelp: Select a node, branch, or menu option to explore. Expand the map for touch panning; use the buttons or Ctrl/⌘ + scroll to zoom.
messages.static.home.preservedGuide: Preserved from the canonical Markdown guide.
messages.static.home.emptyCopy: Try another phrase or choose a different collection.
messages.static.home.maintenanceCopy: Report a dead link, changed price, access problem, or better official source.
messages.static.home.moreDiscover: There is always more to discover.
messages.static.home.moreCopy: This portal is one lovingly tended corner of a much larger open-knowledge ecosystem. Explore thousands of community-curated lists through the project that inspired this experience.
messages.static.home.noscript: This portal needs JavaScript for search and filtering. The complete collection remains available on
messages.static.dashboard.metaDescription: See the shape of Akashic through a calm, interactive overview of its resources, collections, topic paths, and source domains.
messages.static.dashboard.ogDescription: A visual, navigable overview of the Akashic knowledge constellation.
messages.static.dashboard.heroCopy: Step back from individual links and understand how the archive is distributed. Every chart has a complete text path, and every path leads back into the resources.
messages.static.dashboard.dataNote: Built from the curated Markdown at publish time—no analytics, account, live backend, or remote chart library.
messages.static.dashboard.distributionCopy: See how the archive is spread
messages.static.dashboard.ringCopy: The ring shows proportional size. The ranked navigator provides every exact value and the path forward.
messages.static.dashboard.ringAccessible: All collections remain visible in the ring; the adjacent list carries the labels, counts, and controls.
messages.static.dashboard.preparing: Preparing a focused view of its branches and topics.
messages.static.dashboard.signalsCaveat: Large paths reveal depth, while repeated domains reveal where many resources originate. Neither is a quality score.
messages.static.dashboard.intelligenceCopy: See source-file distribution, activity, architecture hotspots, findings, and the generated tree.
messages.static.dashboard.doorway: The overview is a doorway, not a verdict.
messages.static.dashboard.ctaCopy: Use the landscape to orient yourself, then move back into the catalog and follow whatever feels useful now.
messages.static.dashboard.noscript: The Observatory needs JavaScript to draw its derived overview. The complete collection remains available in the
messages.static.atlas.metaDescription: Explore Akashic by place: a growing geographic atlas of official, civic, and community resources.
messages.static.atlas.ogDescription: A place-aware map of useful public and community knowledge.
messages.static.atlas.heroCopy: Move from world to country, region, and community. The resources change with the map—bringing official services, civic life, public data, and trusted local navigators into one calm path.
messages.static.atlas.staticCopy: No map token. No location tracking. No tile bill. Just open geometry and reviewed resources built with the site.
messages.static.atlas.mapDescription: Use the highlighted shapes, place selectors, or breadcrumb to explore available locations.
messages.static.atlas.boundaryNote: Boundaries are simplified for exploration, not legal or navigational use. Map shapes never trigger browser geolocation.
messages.static.atlas.begin: Begin with the highlighted country, then move toward local knowledge.
messages.static.atlas.chooseMapped: Choose a mapped place to reveal its resources.
messages.static.atlas.curateDoorway: Curate the doorway, not the whole internet.
messages.static.atlas.directories: trusted directories and navigators below maintain the deeper, changing details.
messages.static.atlas.smallPurpose: The path starts small on purpose.
messages.static.atlas.provesFlow: This first map proves the world → country → state → locality flow. More places can be added without changing the interface.
messages.static.atlas.geoLayer: A geographic layer for the whole constellation.
messages.static.atlas.seedCopy: Start with official government, library, school, civic, and public-data sources.
messages.static.atlas.reviewCopy: Future discovery jobs should open auditable pull requests instead of silently changing the atlas.
messages.static.atlas.keepAliveCopy: Scheduled checks can flag broken links and stale records while humans retain editorial control.
messages.static.atlas.noscript: The interactive atlas needs JavaScript. Its reviewed source data remains available in the repository's
